newsitem.title: USA: Security Capital completes rights offering.
newsitem.headline: Security Capital completes rights offering.

text.p: Security Capital Industrial Trust said it had successfully completed an over-subscribed rights offering, raising a total of $175.6 million from the sale of 10.2 million common shares at a price of $17.25 per share.
The company said it sold an additional 2.0 million shares in order to meet the demand, raising another $35.1 million.
As a result of these offerings, it said it would have a total of 93.7 million common shares outstanding.
The company did not specify whether the $175.6 million total included the amount earned in the additional share offering.
The proceeds from the offerings will be used to repay borrowings under the company's $350 million unsecured revolving line of bank credit and to take advantage of investment opportunities, it said.
Security Capital is an owner and operator of distribution properties in the United States.
